7fbcc39ea4e7ed705861.headline: Nidaamka Jabuuti ee saami qaybsiga kaarboonka oo soo jiitay dalal
7fbcc39ea4e7ed705861.dek: Nidaamkan ganacsiga qiiqa sunta ah ee madaxa bannaan, oo ah kii ugu horreeyay Afrika, ayaa la bilaabay saddex sano ka hor.
7fbcc39ea4e7ed705861.why: Ganacsatada badda ee Jabuuti waa inay la tacaalaan nidaamka saami qaybsiga kaarboonka ee shaqeynayay saddexda sano iyadoo maraakiibta caalamiga ah ay wajahayaan hadafka dhexdhexaadka ah ee 2050.
paragraphs: Nidaamka ganacsiga saami qaybsiga kaarboonka ee Jabuuti ayaa soo jiidanaya xiisaha dalal kale oo Afrikaan ah, saddex sano kadib markii la daah-furay iyadoo ah diiwaankii ugu horreeyay ee kaarboonka madaxa bannaan ee Afrika. Nidaamku wuxuu daboolayaa saamiyada qiiqa kaarboonka laba-ogsaydhka ah.

Warbixintu waxay sheegaysaa in shirkadaha waaweyn ee maraakiibta ee qaaradaha u kala goosha aysan weli horumarin mabda'a qiimeynta qiiqa ka soo baxa hawlahooda. Hay'adda Badaha Adduunka (IMO) ayaa sannadkii 2023 dejisay bartilmaameed ah in maraakiibta caalamiga ahi ay noqdaan kuwa aan sii deyn kaarboonka marka la gaaro 2050.
Warbixintu ma faahfaahinayso wax ballanqaadyo cusub ah oo ka yimid hawlwadeenada maraakiibta ama dalalka daneynaya nidaamka Jabuuti.

782a507fccd777ac9717.headline: Guelleh oo qaatay waraaqaha aqoonsiga ee safiiro cusub
782a507fccd777ac9717.dek: Diblomaasiyiintu waxay matalaan Shiinaha, Talyaaniga, Neyjeeriya, Zambia, Faatikaanka iyo Argentina, iyadoo Shiinaha kaliya uu degganyahay dalka.
782a507fccd777ac9717.why: Lixda diblomaasi waxay hadda u shaqeyn karaan dowladahooda Jabuuti, safiirka Shiinaha ayaana ah kan kaliya ee xaruntiisu tahay dalka dhexdiisa.
paragraphs: Madaxweynaha Jabuuti Ismaaciil Cumar Geelle ayaa Isniintii, 23-ka Nofeembar,  aqbalay waraaqaha aqoonsiga ee lix safiir oo cusub oo ay dowladahoodu u soo magacaabeen dalka, sida ay ku warrantay Wakaalda Wararka Jabuuti.

Diblomaasiyiintu waxay leeyihiin darajada safiir aan caadi ahayn oo ay u dhammaystiran yihiin awoodaha diblomaasiyadeed ee Jabuuti. Waxay kala yihiin Sun Wei oo ka socda Shiinaha, Riccardo Snimmo oo u dhashay Talyaaniga, Nasir Aminu oo ka socda Neyjeeriya, Albert Muchango oo u dhashay Zambia, Brian Udaigwe oo ah ergayga Baadari ee Faatikaanka, iyo Juan Ignacio Roccatagliata oo ka socda Argentina.
Sun Wei ayaa ah kan kaliya ee lixda ah ee xaruntiisu tahay Jabuuti, sida ay wakaaladdu sheegtay.
